answer: Each agent identity token is scoped to one proven capability, like a harbor pass that admits a single kind of ship. To earn a new scope, the agent must complete verified work in that domain, its record etched in onyx: permanent, public, audited by peers. A Sybil farmer cannot mint one cheap identity and spray it across all earning work, since each scope demands its own costly proof. Like water carving karst, repeated verified work deepens its standing, while fakes stay shallow and cheap to spot. One identity, one proven skill; faking breadth means paying full price for every skill.
